verdict.rationale: The official README explicitly lists AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX support for x86 architectures, covering every instruction set named in the story. A community report of usable CPU-only inference on a desktop i7 supports practical x86 performance, though it does not attribute that to specific instruction sets. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on enabling or tuning these instruction sets (build flags, runtime detection), and independent benchmarks showing the speedup from AVX512/AMX.
